round_2_findings_resolved.title: Service-mesh choice not committed
round_2_findings_resolved.resolution: ADR-0148 authored. Per the externally-applied refinement during review, the canonical choice is Cilium Service Mesh (primary, sidecarless) + Istio Ambient waypoint (Tier-2 opt-in for namespaces needing advanced L7 traffic management). Alternatives considered: Istio classic sidecar (rejected — fleet-wide sidecar overhead), Istio Ambient as-primary (rejected — single-project diversity risk), Linkerd (rejected — smaller ecosystem), AWS App Mesh (rejected — AWS lock-in), no-mesh (rejected — leaks responsibility into app tier).
